description: This line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) scores achieved by four different relation extraction methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—as a function of the number of samples generated, which is plotted on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Samples Generated" and uses a linear scale ranging from K=8 to K=64, with tick marks at regular intervals of K=16. The y-axis is labeled "Micro F1 (%)" and also uses a linear scale, ranging from 25% to 50%, with tick marks at intervals of 5%. The blue line with circular markers represents TACRED, starting at approximately 22% at K=8 and rising to about 29% at K=64. The orange line with triangular markers represents TACRED-Revisit, beginning at around 23% at K=8 and peaking at approximately 31% at K=32 before slightly declining to about 30% at K=64. The green line with diamond markers represents Re-TACRED, starting at roughly 35% at K=8, increasing to a peak of about 51% at K=32, and then decreasing to approximately 48% at K=64. The red line with star markers represents SemEval, which starts at about 42% at K=8 and steadily increases to approximately 52% at K=64.
